messages:
incident-bot: Pager: embeddings-service.p95 > 2.5s (us-west-2) for 3m — paging oncall
maya: seeing it on the dashboard, p95 jump at ~10:04 UTC
samir: joining bridge now, grabbing runbook and recent deploys
kevin: @maya can you check dedicated pool autoscale events? suspect evictions
maya: checking nodes — some evictions logged, KV cache miss rate jumped from 8% -> 42%
maya: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:05:12Z pool-evict: host i-0abcd terminated: OOM (k8s-killer)
2026-03-17T10:05:13Z kvcache: miss keyspace embeddings: hot set thrash
```
lia: starting mitigation steps: disabling background reindex jobs and reducing batch sizes for ingesters
kevin: applied routing tweak: prefer quantized-v2 for embedding requests from low-latency routes (temp)
samir: created bridge (zoom/bridge-332) — invite sent to infra and platform
maya: customer impact: one customer on dedicated pool reported elevated latency, no errors returned, just slower responses
kevin: initiated a controlled rollback of the recent autoscaler bump (policy change #RED-3221) — monitoring
lia: added transient suppression rule for p95 alerts for 10m to avoid alert storm while we stabilize
samir: can we add a quick metric to detect 'eviction storm' and early suppress paging? this is noisy and not actionable until >5 hosts
maya: agree — current pager triggers at p95>2s for 3m, but transient host churn causes floods
kevin: agree with threshold change. Proposal: require either (a) p95>2s for 5m OR (b) p95>2s + host_evictions>=3 in 3m
lia: created ticket RED-3245: "autoscaler policy & eviction detection" — assigned to kevin
samir: scheduling post-incident review: suggested time Thu 16:00 UTC, sends calendar invite after bridge
maya: action items so far:
- RED-3245 (kevin): audit autoscaler policy and restore safe defaults
- RED-3246 (lia): add eviction metric + suppression rule; instrument host_eviction_count
- RED-3247 (maya): update runbook section for embedding service to include cache-warmup steps
- RED-3248 (samir): run a synthetic test for dedicated pool scaling to reproduce churn
kevin: will also prepare a small playbook change to require multi-signal paging (p95 + eviction or error rate)
lia: tentative postmortem owner: maya; I'll help with graphs & playbook text
samir: postmortem slot confirmed Thu 16:00 UTC, invite sent to eng-runtime, eng-sre, product ops
maya: followups: update oncall runbook, change paging rule as kevin proposed, and add SLO note for embeddings (document current target & recent noise)
kevin: temporary mitigation: routing fallback to quantized model reduced p95 to ~1.1s after ~6m
maya: monitoring looks stable for 20m, KV miss rate trending down
lia: final note: avoid suppressing too long — kept suppression 10m only; we'll automate better detection in RED-3246
samir: closing bridge — moving to post-ops channel for action tracking. Please add any stray items to their tickets and update owners. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed at 10:35 UTC (mitigated). Postmortem scheduled (Thu 16:00 UTC).
